notes: Eleven part-level events were identified. Each independently moving leaf of the two paired upper cabinets is reported separately. The first cabinet's two leaves both change state within the same eight-frame sampling intervals, so their individual ordering and midpoints are lower confidence.
scene_description: A first-person traversal of a residential kitchen in which the user sequentially opens and closes a refrigerator, dishwasher, oven, pantry and upper cabinets, then manipulates lids or drawers on three countertop cooking appliances.
